key_aliasHelp: A human-readable name for this virtual key, used only for display and identification.
key_sharedBudgetHelp: Attach this key to a budget rule to share the quota with other keys on the same budget (enforced and accumulated at the gateway).
key_budgetDurationHelp: Reset period for this key's own spend. 'None' means cumulative, no auto reset.
key_maxBudgetHelp: Total spending cap in USD for this key. Requests are rejected once reached. Leave empty or 0 for unlimited.
key_tpmLimitHelp: Maximum tokens per minute (TPM). 0 means unlimited.
key_rpmLimitHelp: Maximum requests per minute (RPM). 0 means unlimited.
key_expiresHelp: When this key expires. It becomes unusable after this time. Leave empty for never.
key_allowedModelsHelp: Restricts this key to only the selected models. Leave empty to allow all deployed models. Call id is "group/name"; selecting a group (e.g. auto) allows all models in that group. Provider is set by the request endpoint (/chat/completions→openai, /messages→anthropic).
key_confirmDeleteContent: Confirm to delete the selected {count} virtual key(s)?
key_deleteWarnBound1: This key is used by instance "{names}". Deleting it will disable AI for that instance. Confirm delete?
key_deleteWarnBound2: Final confirmation: deletion is immediate and irreversible; instance "{names}" will lose LLM access. Delete anyway?
key_rotateConfirmContent: Confirm to rotate key "{name}"? The old key will get a 5-minute grace period.
key_plainWarn: Please save this key immediately; it cannot be viewed again after closing.
key_graceInfo: The old key still has a {minutes}-minute grace period; both keys work during this time.
model_groupHelp: Model grouping. Models under the same group can be load-balanced / failed over.
model_nameHelp: The exposed model name (e.g. gpt-4o). Call id is "group/name" (e.g. auto/gpt-4o); provider is set by the request endpoint (/chat/completions→openai, /messages→anthropic).
model_providerHelp: Upstream provider type, which determines the protocol/auth used to talk to the upstream.
model_providerModelHelp: The real upstream model name (e.g. gpt-4o-2024-08-06) used when calling the upstream.
model_credentialHelp: API credential used to call the upstream for this deployment (required; calls fail without one). Binding multiple distinct credentials under the same group enables load balancing; use weight to set each credential's traffic share.
model_inputPriceHelp: Input token pricing (USD per million tokens), used for cost accounting.
model_outputPriceHelp: Output token pricing (USD per million tokens), used for cost accounting.
model_maxInputTokensHelp: Max input (context) tokens. 0 = not sent; downstream uses the model's default window.
model_maxOutputTokensHelp: Max output tokens (includes reasoning tokens for reasoning models). Set large (e.g. 8192) for reasoning models, or thinking fills the budget and the reply comes back empty. 0 = not sent.
model_weightHelp: Load weight (1-100) within the same group; higher values get a larger share of requests.
model_statusHelp: Enable/disable this model. When disabled it stops accepting new requests.
model_confirmDeleteContent: Confirm to delete the selected {count} model deployment(s)?
group_nameHelp: Group identifier referenced by the model "Group" field. Models under the same group can be load-balanced / failed over.
group_descHelp: Description of the group's purpose; display only, does not affect routing.
group_confirmDeleteContent: Confirm to delete the selected {count} group(s)? Deleting a group does not affect models already referencing it.
credential_apiKeyEditPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep unchanged (stored encrypted)
credential_apiKeyAddPlaceholder: Plain text input, encrypted at backend
credential_importHint: Calls the upstream /v1/models with credential "{name}" and imports all supported models into the group below
credential_confirmDeleteContent: Confirm to delete the selected {count} credential(s)?
mine_alertDesc: Your active budget is running low (<10% left) or exhausted. AI calls will be rejected once exhausted; you can request a temporary budget.
mine_maxBudgetTip: Hard cap: once your spend in the current period reaches this amount, further AI calls are rejected. ∞ means unlimited. Rolls over at the reset time.
mine_softBudgetTip: Soft cap (alert line): reaching this amount only triggers a balance reminder and never blocks requests. '-' means not set.
mine_poolHint: Used/Remaining/Progress are computed only for the Active row: active budget cap − your spend within its period (display-layer calculation, budget data untouched). Other matched budgets show config only and are never affected by your spend.
req_reasonPlaceholder: Explain the purpose and the amount you need
req_submitSuccess: Submitted, pending leader approval (progress in Review · My Submissions)
req_autoApproved: Auto-approved (top rank), temp budget is now active
budget_nameHelp: A human-readable name for this budget rule, used to reference it when configuring keys/teams.
budget_maxBudgetHelp: Hard spending cap in USD. Requests are rejected once reached. Leave empty or 0 for unlimited.
budget_softBudgetHelp: Soft cap in USD. Only triggers an alert/log when reached; requests are not blocked. Should be ≤ the hard cap.
budget_tpmHelp: Maximum tokens per minute (TPM). 0 means unlimited.
budget_rpmHelp: Maximum requests per minute (RPM). 0 means unlimited.
budget_parallelHelp: Maximum number of concurrent in-flight requests. 0 means unlimited.
budget_durationHelp: Reset cycle for budget usage. "None" means it never auto-resets (cumulative).
budget_grantRulesHelp: People covered by this budget (permission group / dept / role condition rows). Empty = not scoped, only effective via virtual-key attachment; when a user matches multiple budgets, any one with remaining quota passes.
budget_confirmDeleteContent: Confirm to delete the selected {count} budget record(s)?
